name: Hutch E sample stage (Aero SMS) with its Aero translation base
note: Listed TOP to BOTTOM, which is also the order of the green buttons on the Aero_SMS panel (sam_Rx, sam_Rz, samZ, samX, samY, Aero Rot (Ry)) and matches the hardware (p01: pin holder > Kohzu M3&M4 tilt stack > E34/E36 stages > E35 > Aerotech rotation > E101 Aero X). Limits/readbacks are the operator-panel values at 2026-10-20 (snapshot, not defaults). Panel caution: 'motor orientation valid only when Aero Rot (Ry) = 0'.
axes: +Y up, +Z beam direction, +X into the screen (right-handed); looking downstream +x is to the left

stack_top_to_bottom.name: pin holder
stack_top_to_bottom.notes: Brass screw with the pin on top (BLADE alignment pin). Pin silhouette is what the tomo camera sees.

stack_top_to_bottom.name: samTh (Rx)
stack_top_to_bottom.hardware: Kohzu M3&M4 tilt stack (tag E86 0.5 Deg/S, 0.00012 Deg/Step)

stack_top_to_bottom.name: samZE
stack_top_to_bottom.blade_role: z: cancels the sin(omega) term b

stack_top_to_bottom.name: samXE
stack_top_to_bottom.blade_role: x: cancels the cos(omega) term a

stack_top_to_bottom.name: samYE
stack_top_to_bottom.hardware: tag E35 (5W, +/-15 mm, 0.05 um/step, max speed 0.5)

stack_top_to_bottom.name: Aero Rot (Ry)
stack_top_to_bottom.hardware: Aerotech Accudex ABRS-300MP (tag PO73994). 'Aero 0 point: to calib/home, move to 5 deg then HomF'

stack_top_to_bottom.name: Aero Z (in E)
stack_top_to_bottom.notes: Not visible in the photos; position in the stack below the rotation relative to Aero X is not established.

stack_top_to_bottom.name: Aero X (in E)
stack_top_to_bottom.role: base translation, moves the whole rotation axis horizontally
stack_top_to_bottom.blade_role: base: moves the axis column c (-1431 px/mm on gh1, measured 2026-10-28)
